verdict.rationale: The Division documents a fax-filing rail, though it runs through its own 'New Jersey Fax Filing' online application (docs-4). It names specific paper forms (CD-100 and CD-101) for one filing type and publishes an email address for filing concerns. This is only a glancing, partial fallback: the fax rail itself depends on an online application, and no mailing address or fax number is given. Missing for 10: published mailing address for paper filings, explicit fax number, a complete list of downloadable paper forms covering the core formation and annual-report tasks, and guidance on using these rails when the online flow is unavailable.
